paginas.titulo: Golden dorado fishing trip with friends: how many days, how much it costs, and where to stay (2026/27)
paginas.bajada: Three ways to plan a golden dorado trip with friends on the Paraná: per-person prices for each, what's included, and how many days are best.
paginas.seo_title: Golden dorado fishing trip with friends: 2026/27 prices
paginas.seo_description: How much a golden dorado fishing trip with friends in Argentina costs: from US$ 605 per person at an inn to US$ 4,050 at a lodge. Days and what's included.
datos: Inn in Esquina (Corrientes): 2 fishing days and 3 nights from US$ 605 per person in a group of three and from US$ 705 in a group of two, with meals, boat, guide, and license.
Houseboat in the Paraná Delta: 3 nights from US$ 1,260 and 4 nights from US$ 1,680 per person.
All-inclusive lodge in Corrientes: 3 nights and 2 fishing days from US$ 4,050 per person; 7 nights and 6 days US$ 7,950.
The more days, the cheaper each fishing day: at an inn in Esquina, it drops from US$ 353 to US$ 326 per person between 2 and 4 days.
The extraordinary fishing ban on the Paraná in Corrientes was lifted on 29 September 2026.

bloques.h: Short answer. For a dorado trip with friends, it's best to go for 2 to 4 fishing days. The per-person price depends more on the type of lodging than the number of days: from US$ 605 to US$ 705 at an inn (2 fishing days, 3 nights), from US$ 1,260 on a Delta houseboat, and from US$ 4,050 at an all-inclusive lodge. All prices are per person, in US dollars, not including travel.
Three ways to do it, with prices

filas: Lodging, meals, drinks, boat, guide, bait, fuel, and license
Same, with the price split among three
Double lodging, all meals and drinks, guide, and loaner gear
Same; does not include license, transfers, or travel

bloques.h: Prices published or reported as of 5 November 2026, per person in double room and shared guide. Each lodge's rates by number of nights are in how much a golden dorado fishing trip costs.
How many days are best for a dorado trip with friends?

Our opinion, based on published numbers: 3 nights and 2 fishing days if time is short, since a windy or rainy day matters less than on a one-day trip; and 4 nights and 3 days if you're traveling from far away, as the cost per fishing day drops and travel is already paid. At an inn in Esquina, the per-person, per-fishing-day cost goes from US$ 353 (2 days) to US$ 337 (3 days) and US$ 326 (4 days), for a group of two. These are our calculations.
Multi-day packages at an inn in Esquina

Posada Hambaré, National Route 12, km 688, Esquina. "From" prices as of 4 November 2026; the inn does not publish the season for these rates. Includes lodging; breakfast, lunch, and dinner; soft drinks, water, beer, and unlimited wine; boat, fishing guide, two dozen live baits per person, 50 liters of fuel, and fishing license. Totals and cost per fishing day are our calculations.
How much for your group?
Our calculation, not including travel or gear. For 4 and 6 friends, you need to confirm the inn has two boats available on your dates and that each group keeps its price.
What if you prefer a one-day trip?

A guide in Esquina advertises a full day on the boat with guide from $ 480,000 per boat, or $ 160,000 per person if there are three (1 November 2026, in pesos). In Paso de la Patria, none of the operators we checked publish a day rate: offers say "all inclusive" or "inquire." We do not set the exchange rate between pesos and dollars: confirm it when booking.
Is there a fishing ban on the Paraná in Corrientes now?

filas: Order 618: ban between km 1232 and 1238, due to a concentration of surubí
Extended to km 1180 to 1239, Paso de la Patria jurisdiction, for dorado and sábalo
Order 1054: ban lifted and regulations from Order 853/22 reinstated

bloques.h: Corrientes Department of Natural Resources. We found no ban after 4 November 2026, but the rules allow it to be reinstated if fish concentrations reappear: ask your guide before heading out. Since Order 853/22, dorado and surubí must be released in Corrientes.
Do I need a fishing license?

Yes. In Corrientes, you get the sport fishing license online and carry it with your ID. It's already included in Esquina inn packages and some lodges; in others, it's not (the Corrientes lodges in the nights table do not include it). Always ask.
Want help planning? Tell us your dates, number of friends, and budget in the trip form and we'll send you guide and lodging options, free of charge and with no obligation.
What this page doesn't cover yet
Bus and flight schedules from Buenos Aires, the Corrientes license price, and a month-by-month calendar with technical sources. We'll add them once we verify with a date.

paginas.titulo: How much does a dorado fishing trip in Argentina cost: all-inclusive lodges by number of nights (2026/27)
paginas.bajada: Per person rates for dorado lodges in Corrientes, Iberá, the Paraná in Santa Fe, and the Delta, with what's included and the cost per fishing day.
paginas.seo_title: How much does a dorado fishing trip cost (2026/27)
paginas.seo_description: Dorado lodge prices in Argentina for 2026/27: from US$ 4,050 for 3 nights to US$ 7,950 for 7 nights, per person, with what's included and cost per day.
datos: An all-inclusive lodge on the Upper Paraná in Corrientes costs from US$ 4,050 (3 nights, 2 fishing days) to US$ 7,950 (7 nights, 6 days) per person in double occupancy.
Each extra fishing day lowers the price per day: from US$ 2,025 with 2 days to US$ 1,325 with 6 days at the same lodge.
Iberá Wetlands: one lodge lists 7 nights and 6 days from US$ 6,400 per person, in a single room.
Paraná in Santa Fe: 4 fishing days from US$ 3,600; a special of 3 days and 4 nights at US$ 2,500 on selected dates from December 2026 to February 2027.
Fishing licenses and transfers are usually not included: add them in.

bloques.h: Short answer. An all-inclusive dorado trip at a lodge in Argentina costs, per person in a double room, from US$ 4,050 for 3 nights and 2 fishing days to US$ 7,950 for 7 nights and 6 days on the Upper Paraná (Corrientes). In Iberá and the Paraná in Santa Fe there are options from US$ 2,500 to US$ 6,400. For a cheaper trip, see the friends' trip at an inn (from US$ 605).
Price ladder by number of nights (Paraná, Corrientes)

2026/27 rate for two Upper Paraná lodges in Corrientes (one open October 2026 to May 2027 and the other year-round), same price. Per person, double room, shared guide. Includes lodging, all meals, wine, beer and drinks, professional guide, and loaner gear (rods, reels, and lines). Does not include flights, transfers, fishing license, laundry, or tips. Single room and boat: 60% surcharge. Non-fishing companion: US$ 650 per night. Full fishing day on arrival or departure: US$ 950 per boat.
Other lodges and formats

filas: Double. Includes charter flights from Buenos Aires, transfers, license, flies, and gear. 2026/27 season
Single room and shared guide; 2-for-1 introductory rate depending on the lodge
Double; includes transfer from Corrientes and license. Published rate for September to May 2025: reconfirm
Selected dates from December 2026 to February 2027

bloques.h: Prices published or reported as of 5 November 2026, in US dollars, as shown by each operator. Each operator includes different things: just comparing the number can be misleading.
How many days are best?

The price per fishing day drops with each extra day: in the ladder above it goes from US$ 2,025 with 2 days to US$ 1,325 with 6. If budget is tight, 3 nights and 2 days is the minimum worth considering; if you're coming from far away, 5 nights and 4 days already covers a bad weather day without losing your week.
What is usually not included in the price?

items: The fishing license: in Corrientes you get it online; some lodges include it, others don't.
Flights and transfers to the lodge, unless listed as included.
Single supplement: if you travel alone and want your own room and boat, the surcharge can be up to 60%.

paginas.titulo: How much does a day of fly fishing cost in Bariloche and the Limay River (2026/27)
paginas.bajada: Price for a guided fishing day on the Limay River: in US dollars and Argentine pesos, what's included, license cost, and what changes if there are two anglers.
paginas.seo_title: How much is fishing in Bariloche and the Limay (2026/27)
paginas.seo_description: Price for a day of guided fly fishing on the Limay River, Bariloche: from US$ 500 to US$ 545 per boat in dollars and from $ 666,000 in pesos. What's included.
datos: A full day of guided fly fishing on the Limay with boat costs between US$ 500 and US$ 545 (one angler), depending on the outfitter.
For two anglers in the same boat, one outfitter lists US$ 520: the second angler adds only US$ 20.
In pesos, a guide on a booking platform lists $ 666,000 per day for up to two people (March 2027).
Fishing licenses are usually not included: one outfitter reports US$ 30 per day for foreigners, US$ 90 per week, and US$ 180 per season.
The best time according to one outfitter is from November to May.

bloques.h: Short answer. A full day of guided fly fishing on the Limay River, about 45 minutes from Bariloche, costs between US$ 500 and US$ 545 per boat, and $ 666,000 in pesos on a booking platform (up to two people). The fishing license is almost always paid separately.
Prices for a day on the Limay River

filas: US$ 500 one angler; US$ 520 two anglers
Boat, fishing gear, Patagonian lunch with wine, soft drinks, beer, and transfers
Boat for up to 2 people, transfer from Bariloche hotels, bilingual guide, full gear, snack or lunch with drinks
Guide, boat, lunch, gear, and transfers

bloques.h: Prices published or reported as of 5 November 2026. The prices in dollars and pesos are from different operators and are not converted between each other: each sets their own exchange rate at booking.
How much for two anglers?

At the outfitter listing both rates, one angler pays US$ 500 and two anglers in the same boat pay US$ 520 total: the second angler adds only US$ 20. Per person, going as a pair is almost half price (our calculation: US$ 260 per person).
How much is the fishing license?

A Bariloche outfitter reports these license rates: US$ 10 per day for Argentines and US$ 30 per day for foreigners; US$ 90 per week and US$ 180 per season for foreigners; US$ 30 per season for Argentines. This is the outfitter's information, not an official rate: confirm with the provincial authority before fishing.
When is the best time to go?
A local outfitter indicates the best time is from November to May. This is one outfitter's description; the official season and closures are in our Patagonia trout season guide.

paginas.titulo: How much does a week of trout fishing cost in Neuquén and Chubut: all-inclusive lodges (2026/27)
paginas.bajada: Rates per person for trout lodges in Junín de los Andes, Cholila, Futaleufú, and Trevelin: from 3 to 7 nights, with what each one includes.
paginas.seo_title: How much is a week of trout fishing (2026/27)
paginas.seo_description: Price for a week of fly fishing at lodges in Neuquén and Chubut in 2026/27: from US$ 3,950 for 3 nights to US$ 9,200 for 7 nights, per person.
datos: A lodge on the Chimehuín River (Junín de los Andes, Neuquén) costs from US$ 3,950 (3 nights, 2 fishing days) to US$ 6,950 (7 nights, 6 days) per person, from December 2026 to April 2027.
A lodge chain in Chubut lists 7 nights and 6 fishing days from US$ 6,545 (Trevelin) up to US$ 9,200 (Cholila), in high season.
A hosted week in Trevelin, from 6 to 13 March 2027, costs US$ 5,800 per angler and includes licenses and transfers from Esquel.
These prices are per person in double occupancy with shared guide.

bloques.h: Short answer. A week of fly fishing at an all-inclusive lodge in Argentine Patagonia costs, per person and in double occupancy, from US$ 5,800 to US$ 9,200 for 7 nights and 6 fishing days. In Neuquén, a Chimehuín lodge lists the full range, from US$ 3,950 for 3 nights to US$ 6,950 for 7.
Neuquén: price scale by nights (Chimehuín River, Junín de los Andes)
Rates from December 2026 to April 2027, per person, in double occupancy with shared guide. The official season opens on 1 November, but this lodge usually opens its doors on 1 December.
Chubut: 7-night, 6-day week (Cholila, Futaleufú, and Trevelin)

filas: 7 nights, 6 fishing days, meals, drinks, transfers from Esquel and licenses

bloques.h: Prices published or reported as of 5 November 2026. Lodges in the chain offer weeks from Saturday to Saturday; prices vary by date and some lodges accept stays of other lengths. Includes lodging, meals, drinks, and guide. License and airfare are confirmed with each operator.
How many days are best?

At the Neuquén lodge with the full range, each extra fishing day lowers the price per day: from US$ 1,975 with 2 days to US$ 1,158 with 6. A stay of 4 nights and 3 days is the shortest that justifies the trip; a full week makes the most of the transfer.
When is the season?
Each province sets its own dates. The ones we checked, with their sources, are in our season guide and in the fishing calendar.

paginas.titulo: How much does it cost to fish in Tierra del Fuego and El Calafate: sea-run trout and day trips (2026/27)
paginas.bajada: The price of a week of sea-run trout at a Río Grande lodge and a half-day or full-day trip in El Calafate, with what each includes.
paginas.seo_title: How much does it cost to fish Tierra del Fuego & Calafate
paginas.seo_description: Fishing prices in southern Patagonia: a week of sea-run trout in Río Grande from US$ 12,950 and a day trip in El Calafate from $ 440,000.
datos: A week at a sea-run trout lodge in Río Grande (Tierra del Fuego) costs from US$ 12,950 to US$ 14,950 per person, depending on the date, in the 2026/27 season.
That lodge rate is for a single room and shared guide, and includes meals, drinks, and transfer from the airport.
In El Calafate, a half-day trip (5 hours) costs $ 440,000 per angler and a full-day trip (9 hours) $ 720,000.
In El Calafate, fishing is from the shore, wading; non-fishing companions pay $ 185,000 for half-day and $ 335,000 for full-day.

bloques.h: Short answer. In southern Patagonia there are two published price points. A week of sea-run trout at a Río Grande lodge (Tierra del Fuego) costs from US$ 12,950 to US$ 14,950 per person. A day trip in El Calafate costs $ 440,000 (half-day) or $ 720,000 (full-day) per angler, in pesos.
Sea-run trout in Río Grande: week at a lodge

Río Grande lodge rate for the season from 26 December 2026 to 17 April 2027, checked on 4 November 2026. Includes lodging, transfer from Río Grande airport, all meals and drinks, professional guide (two anglers per guide), and loaner gear. Does not include flights, fishing license (the lodge estimates about US$ 550 per angler), laundry, or tips. A 50% deposit is required and is non-refundable. Other operators we found in Río Grande do not publish rates; the destination guide is at fishing in Río Grande.
El Calafate: half-day or full-day trip

Prices in pesos published by an El Calafate agency, as of 5 November 2026. Includes transfer from the hotel, fishing guide, full fly or spinning gear, drinks, hot beverages, insurance, and fishing permits. Fishing is catch and release, from the shore, wading; no boat fishing. Locations are about 50 minutes from El Calafate and are chosen the same day based on weather and water levels.
What extra costs should you expect?

items: Flights to Río Grande or El Calafate: lodge rates start at the airport.
Fishing license in Tierra del Fuego: the lodge estimates about US$ 550 per angler per week.
